# telnyx_ai_mission_clone (Action)

Copies an AI mission into a new mission. Terraform does not manage the copy; import it as a telnyx_ai_mission to manage it.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mission_id` (String) The mission id.
